name: report-problem-send
description: reportProblem when the user chose, in the options page, to let an assistant send a report once it has asked them (reportDelivery send), while the block of skipReview for mail keeps its default, on. A report with send true goes to the project's mailbox through the local SMTP sink, with no draft, and says that the user may not have read it; a report without send is a draft; the fourth send of the day is a draft with the reason, and the seventh message of the day is only listed. A mail address written in a report is replaced in what is sent.
